CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2368 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (R10-PUMP-MODEL D2, branch fix/r10-pump-model-d2), head c3a25d2ae337d82a8401dcfc1ab0f0f7e34aa38b. Never send push notifications.
The newest `Fix review:` is blocked: ci-red: fast (3.14) is red at this head on tests/optimality.py's ftol check (60.96 vs 60.96, -0.00% against a 2.5% bound); the ruling's step 2 (the kernel matrix and the ftol re-derivation) and step 4 (each re-planned scenario's solver work stated against the baseline) are still pending in the body, and kernel-points has never run on this branch. Read it and the ruling it cites in full; complete steps 2 and 4 with measurements, make fast green soundly (never loosen the bound to fit), and get kernel-points to run on the branch (the label exists).
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain is on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor. Run tests/entities.py with `env -u BASH_ENV`.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from origin/main and follow them exactly. Merge origin/main, never rebase. Re-execute steps 2-8 and re-take the body in full; answer every red check in `## Red checks`.
Return: push code to `handoff/r10-pump-model-d2` (fast-forward) and the body via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh to `handoff-body/r10-pump-model-d2`. Push nothing else; do not open, edit, comment on or merge any PR. A fixer writes no delivery row. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it. End with CODE=<sha> BODY=<sha>.
